items.title: Welcoming and experienced salon team
items.text: Clients speak warmly of owner Eva and her assistant Arkeece on W Bellfort Ave, emphasizing their kind attitudes and deep pet care knowledge. Dog owners appreciate the personalized attention, noting that the staff consistently makes them feel like trusted family members.

items.title: Fresh cleaning and skilled grooming
items.text: Pet owners report that their dogs return home looking thoroughly groomed, fresh, and smelling wonderful after each appointment. Reviewers praise the high standard of bath and trim work, noting that even difficult coats are shaped skillfully and reliably.

items.title: Patience with difficult rescue dogs
items.text: Reviewers emphasize how gentle and calm the groomers remain with nervous rescues and dogs that are wary of unfamiliar people. Clients note that their pets build genuine trust with Eva over repeat visits, arriving excited rather than anxious on grooming days.

faq.q: Can they groom shy or fearful rescue dogs?
faq.a: Yes, reviewers specifically mention that staff handled difficult rescue dogs with patience and calm care.
The salon is operated by owner Eva, whom regular clients frequently mention for her hands-on pet care.

faq.q: Are pets clean and well-scented after visits?
faq.a: Yes, pet owners consistently note that dogs return home fresh, clean, and smelling great.
